empty.title: Buy your first stock
empty.text: Add the supplier you buy from, then create a purchase in cartons per flavour. When it arrives, its landed cost is worked out for you.
empty.lateText: Every open purchase is still within its expected date.

noSupplier.text: Add a supplier and approve it for the flavours it makes, then come back to order.

waiting.note: When {number} is received, Allocate opens on Overview and Inventory.
